A conversation with a language model

Source: R/llm_native.R
bricklayer_llm_chat.Rd

Sends a whole conversation (system, user and assistant turns) to the route bricklayer_llm_ask would take, and returns the reply. Unlike bricklayer_llm_ask() it adds nothing to the conversation: no help pages, no tools.

Usage

bricklayer_llm_chat(messages, model = NULL, route = NULL, timeout = 120)

Arguments

messages

A list of turns, each list(role = , content = ) with role "system", "user" or "assistant".

model

Model id; default the route's own (see above).

route

NULL (the saved route, else the first that is set up), "auto" (the automatic order this time, ignoring a saved route), or "own", "ollama" or a provider id to insist on one.

timeout

Seconds to wait for the reply.

Value

The reply text.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bricklayer_llm_chat(list(list(role = "user", content = "Name one survey weight type.")))
} # }
